description.fun: A gluttonous, rather dim seabird that tries to swallow everything whole, ideally an Arrokuda. Sometimes it grabs a Pikachu by mistake and just carries on with it stuck in its throat. It can forget what it's battling mid-fight, but never forgets a Trainer it trusts. Its orange shiny colouring may come from British news stories about gulls dyed orange by falling into curry sauce.
description.guide: A Flying and Water-type seabird Pokémon based on the cormorant. Cramorant tries to swallow prey whole, and changes into Gulping Form with an Arrokuda in its mouth or Gorging Form with a Pikachu stuck in its throat. It is strong but forgetful.
description.tagline: A forgetful seabird that swallows prey whole, Pikachu included

description.fun: Cramorant with an Arrokuda stuck in its throat. Hit it and it spits the thrashing fish out at high speed, a trick that may borrow from traditional cormorant fishing.
Cramorant with a whole Pikachu lodged in its gullet. It's choking a little but won't let go, and the Pikachu's prickling electricity gives attackers a shock.
